title: Basic HTTP Server
description: Creates a simple server using the built-in http module.
explanation_md: Uses the core `http` module to create a server that listens on port 3000 and responds with 'Hello World'.

title: Stream File Download
description: Streams a file from the filesystem to an HTTP response.
explanation_md: Streaming files is more memory-efficient than reading the entire file into memory before sending it to the client.

title: Event Emitter Example
explanation_md: Node.js's event-driven architecture uses the `EventEmitter` class to facilitate communication between different parts of an application.

title: Promisified fs.readFile
description: Reading a file using async/await with the promises API.
explanation_md: Uses the newer `fs.promises` API to perform asynchronous file operations with a cleaner syntax than callbacks.

title: Worker Threads for Heavy Tasks
description: Offloading CPU-intensive tasks to a worker thread.
explanation_md: Worker threads allow Node.js to perform multi-threaded execution, which is useful for CPU-bound tasks like image processing or complex calculations.
